name: mofa-fm
author: hagency
description: Voice management and TTS with custom voice cloning via ominix-api

install.label: OminiX API server (Apple Silicon TTS inference)

ominix-api.description: Local inference server for Qwen3 TTS with voice cloning on Apple Silicon

ominix-mlx.description: MLX inference runtime for Qwen3-TTS on Apple Silicon

tools.name: fm_tts
tools.description: Synthesize speech from text. Supports long text — the server automatically splits text at sentence boundaries and streams audio per-sentence, so you can pass an entire article or news broadcast in one call without splitting it yourself. Do NOT manually break text into smaller pieces. Supports preset voices and custom saved voices. If a custom voice name is given, voice cloning is used automatically. After generating, use send_file to deliver the audio to the user.

text.description: The text to synthesize into speech

voice.description: Voice name: a preset ('vivian', 'serena', 'ryan', etc.) or a saved custom voice name. Default: 'vivian' or the user's default voice.

output_path.description: Path to save the audio file. Leave empty — the file is automatically saved to the workspace directory.

prompt.description: Style/emotion prompt to control how the voice speaks. Works with both preset and cloned voices. Verified Chinese prompts (best with Chinese speakers like vivian, serena): excited='用兴奋激动的语气说话，充满热情和活力', sad='用悲伤失望的语气说话，声音低沉，语速缓慢', cheerful='用开朗愉快的语气说话，声音明亮上扬，节奏轻快', shout='用大声喊叫的方式说话，声音高亢有力，语速快', sarcastic='用讽刺嘲讽的语气说话，语调阴阳怪气，拖长尾音', soft='用温柔轻柔的语气说话', panic='用惊慌恐惧的语气说话，声音颤抖，语速急促'. English prompts (best with English speakers like ryan, aiden): excited='Speak with excitement and enthusiasm, full of energy', sad='Speak in a sad, disappointed tone, voice low and slow', cheerful='Speak cheerfully with a bright, upbeat voice', shout='Shout loudly with a powerful, high-pitched voice', sarcastic='Speak sarcastically with a mocking, drawn-out tone', soft='Speak gently and softly', panic='Speak in a panicked, trembling voice, fast and breathless'. Custom free-form prompts also supported — include emotion + timbre + pace descriptors for strongest control.

speed.description: Speed factor: >1.0 = faster, <1.0 = slower. Range 0.5-2.0. Default: 1.0

tools.name: fm_voice_save
tools.description: Save an audio file as a named custom voice for future TTS use. The audio should be 3-10 seconds of clear speech from the target speaker. Once saved, use the name with fm_tts to synthesize speech in that voice.

name.description: Name for the voice (alphanumeric and underscores only, e.g. 'my_voice', 'boss')

audio_path.description: Absolute path to the audio file to use as voice reference

tools.name: fm_voice_list
tools.description: List all available voices: both preset voices and saved custom voices.

tools.name: fm_voice_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved custom voice by name.

name.description: Name of the custom voice to delete
